description: Full detail of one rentable server from the Pulse Celestia datacenter catalog, by the id that list_datacenter_offers prints: hardware, price and setup fee, upgrade options (storage, RAM, bandwidth tiers with prices), traffic terms, provider notes, the Pulse compatibility verdict with every reason for each node role in both the real and the docs envelope, the FDP hosting-rule verdict per role, how many Celestia validators already run on the same provider, and the provider status page incidents. Celestia node hosting only. A snapshot, not a quote: confirm price and stock on the provider order page. The id changes when a provider changes the configuration, so an id from an old answer may be gone.
name: get_datacenter_offer
